postal_system.assignment_rule: Guatemala uses five numeric digits. The current Correos de Guatemala department directories are assignment evidence only when every source PDF, retrieval time and digest is pinned; the November 2025 UPU sheet is current coding and layout evidence. Valid syntax, a department prefix, municipality, Guatemala City zone, rural-locality or administrative match is not proof of a current assignment, exact civic address, building relation, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A full Guatemalan code may denote a department, municipality, Guatemala City zone, named locality, distribution route or delivery-office context and is not guaranteed to be a polygon. The official directory tables do not publish geometry. A SEGEPLAN, INE, IGN, RIC or OSM area, Voronoi cell, buffer, interpolation, API cache or model surface cannot be presented as official postal geometry; assignment authority, geometry authority and reuse rights remain explicit.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention or title, organization, street, house number, neighborhood, zone or colonia, premises or building, centre, tower, apartment, kilometre, finca, lot, P.O. Box, locality or rural locality, municipality, department and postcode separately. Synthetic fixtures contain no real Correos or UPU result, address, building, organization or person.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as urban_zone, municipality, rural_locality, routing_area, delivery_office, po_box, organization or unknown. A five-digit assignment must not be forced to polygon geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, release, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. Postcode, parcel, zone, locality, street, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: SEGEPLAN, INE, IGN and RIC identifiers, boundaries, populated places, cartography and parcels are contextual evidence only. Pin object type, producer, vintage, code, CRS, licence and crosswalk; do not relabel them as Correos assignments or postal geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted operator observations and rights-cleared geospatial releases may normalize input, validate or enrich a candidate, compare observations, compress reviewed geometry, detect drift and produce mathematical or machine-learning review surfaces. Every output preserves source and service version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and authoritative, official-derived or derived status. It never overwrites source evidence, manufactures official postal geometry or infers a house number, apartment, building, organization, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound Guatemalan assignment observations, typed postal objects, permitted reference geometry, rights-cleared civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative context to AGID cells without relabelling a source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Guatemalan postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The public Correos website, official department PDFs and UPU addressing sheet are not blanket open bulk-data licences. Each SEGEPLAN layer, INE resource, IGN product and RIC service retains exact producer, release, access, reuse, derived-output and redistribution terms; public visibility or OGC access is not permission to redistribute. INE CC BY and ODbL material remain separately attributed and partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO GT scope and records border, water, departmental, municipal, urban, rural and source-specific coverage explicitly. Postal, administrative, statistical, cartographic, cadastral, civic-address, building and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and vintage remain independent.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact civic addresses, apartments, coordinates, access points, fincas, parcels, organizations, P.O. Boxes, API responses, credentials and query logs can expose sensitive household, property or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; never bundle people, occupants, owners or account secrets.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal assignments, operator observations, the November 2025 UPU sheet, department directory PDFs, legal and administrative changes, SEGEPLAN layers, the 2018 INE census release, IGN or RIC products, community data, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version, service version, release, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with source licence, release, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Restricted Correos, UPU, SEGEPLAN, IGN or RIC inputs remain private, gated or external according to their terms. Dataset Viewer is discovery and preview, a Space is a demonstration surface, and production AGID services must pin a Hub commit and verify artifact digests. Generated polygons remain derived review surfaces until promotion checks pass.
